name: Gisou Kanojo
source:
The protagonist, Mao Shinguji, is an apprentice exorcist monk whose profession is hunting demons. During the day, he lives a normal student life, but at the rest of the time, he devotes himself to his training at the temple where he lives. One night, Mao senses an unusual "demonic energy" in town and rushes to the scene, where he finds a seductive girl standing there completely naked. Her name is Luara, the "Princess of the Demon World Tree." She has come to the human world incognito to broaden her knowledge as the successor to support the demon world.

[Translated from Official Website]
translation:
主人公真宫寺真雄是一名以讨伐妖魔为业的见习退魔僧。白天，他过着普通学生的生活，其余时间则在自己居住的寺院中潜心修行。某天夜里，真雄察觉镇上出现了异常的“妖气”，赶往现场后，发现一名美艳少女正赤身站在那里。她名叫露阿拉，是“魔界树的公主”。身为未来支撑魔界的继承者，她隐瞒身份来到人界，意在增长见闻。

[译自官方网站]
